title: GPS Exchange Format (GPX) 1.1
claims: GPX is an XML schema for exchanging GPS data.
GPX 1.1 defines track, route and waypoint structures with latitude, longitude and optional elevation.

verification.note: GPX 1.1 schema 文档可读：含 wptType、rteType、trkType、trksegType，属性 lat/lon 必填、ele 可选。

claimVerification.note: schema 文档首页说明 GPX 为 XML schema。
